title: Design Patterns
description: Use three named shapes for classes on a pretend robot: swap drive modes with Strategy, tell the LEDs and intake about a game piece with Observer, and build the right auto from its name with Factory.

checkpoints.title: Two drive modes
checkpoints.description: TankDrive and ArcadeDrive implement DriveMode; arcade mixes forward and turn and clamps each side between -1 and 1.

checkpoints.title: Swap the strategy
checkpoints.description: Drivetrain holds a DriveMode, drives with whichever one it has, and switches with setMode (ignoring null).

checkpoints.title: Tell the listeners
checkpoints.description: BeamBreak adds and removes listeners, and update() tells each of them, in order, only when the reading changes.

checkpoints.title: The auto factory
checkpoints.description: AutoFactory.create builds a new auto from a dashboard name, ignoring case and spaces, with Do nothing for anything it doesn't know.
